evidence: Provenance is not normalized: 23,426 edges have no `sources` field, 7,614 have an empty list, 5,914 one source, 743 multiple.
metric: 37,697 edges: 23,426 no sources field, 7,614 empty list, 5,914 one source, 694 two, 49 three; 36,954 single-source, 743 multi-source; top sources STRINGDB 2,667, CTD_human 2,306, UNIPROT 436, Reactome 361
observation: A count over the built graph showed most emitted edges carry no usable source list, and relation-specific fields (PMIDs, PPI scores, GO evidence codes) do not substitute for a uniform source-diversity measure. This blocks a uniform accuracy/explainability statement about independent corroboration.
